AIFF Members Revolt Against President Chaubey's Fixed Deposit Plan

Members of the All India Football Federation (AIFF) have revolted against a proposal by President Kalyan Chaubey to liquidate the federation's fixed deposit. The funds were intended to cover expenses for friendly matches. The members stalled Chaubey's move, creating turmoil within the AIFF.
